summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, reporting the purchase of 8,740,351 ordinary shares for cancellation under its share buyback program announced on March 12, 2026. Purchases were executed on the London Stock Exchange and other venues from April 13-17 at volume-weighted average prices between 353 pence and 362 pence per share. The buyback aims to return capital to shareholders by reducing the outstanding share count. Following settlement, the registered share capital was 8,911,083,689 shares with 12,320,645 held in treasury. This is a routine capital return via open-market repurchases; no activist involvement, acquisition, or strategic review. Watch for continued execution of the buyback program.
